ui.generateAtlases: Generate atlases (repack UV islands into shared atlases)
ui.mipmapStreaming: Mipmaps + Mip Streaming (bound together, VRChat requirement)
ui.densityInvalid: Minimum density cannot exceed maximum density.
ui.dedupMaterials: Deduplicate materials (and merge identical opaque slots)
ui.autoRW: Temporarily enable Read/Write on inputs (restored afterwards)
ui.currentPlatform: Current platform (read from the active build target)
ui.losslessHint: All parameters are at lossless values: island scaling is skipped entirely and pixels are copied without resampling.
